description: Fix WebSocket disconnect loop, add polling results fetch fallback, add WebSocket keepalive ping, and add export analysis endpoint + UI button.
steps: Add getAnalysisResults(sessionId) and getAnalysisExport(sessionId) functions to frontend/src/services/api.ts
Add WebSocket keepalive ping (send {type:'ping'} every 15s) to frontend/src/services/websocket.ts
In AnalysisPage.tsx startPolling callback, when statusData.status === 'completed': call getAnalysisResults, transform with transformBackendResults, set results in store
Add GET /api/analysis/{session_id}/export endpoint to backend/src/api/routes/analysis.py returning full JSON
Add 'Exportar Analisis' button in AnalysisPage.tsx that appears after completion and triggers JSON download via getAnalysisExport
acceptance_criteria: WebSocket sends keepalive ping every 15 seconds to prevent idle disconnects
When polling detects status='completed', frontend fetches full results from /api/analysis/{session_id}/results and displays them
Backend has GET /api/analysis/{session_id}/export endpoint that returns all player metrics as downloadable JSON
Frontend shows 'Exportar Analisis' button when analysis completes
Clicking the export button downloads a JSON file with all analysis data
